name: Hybrid MPPI/iCEM with rank blend
tagline: iCEM-style elite retention + colored noise + adaptive temperature, with the MPPI softmax score blended with rank weights and a momentum mean update.

key_hyperparams.name: keep_fraction
key_hyperparams.role: iCEM elite retention

key_hyperparams.name: momentum
key_hyperparams.role: weight on prior mean (after iter 0)

key_hyperparams.name: temp_start_mult
key_hyperparams.role: MPPI temperature multiplier at iter 0

key_hyperparams.name: temp_end_mult
key_hyperparams.role: MPPI temperature multiplier at last iter

key_hyperparams.name: noise_beta
key_hyperparams.role: AR(1) coefficient for colored noise

key_hyperparams.name: rank_blend
key_hyperparams.role: weight on rank-based score in score blend

init_recovers: Standard MPPI when keep_fraction=0, momentum=0, rank_blend=0, noise_beta=0, temp mults=1
diff_from_baseline: Combines pieces from iCEM (elite retention, colored noise) with MPPI (softmax-weighted moment update + Gumbel selection), and adds (a) per-iteration ramp of MPPI temperature, (b) blend of softmax score with rank-based weights to reduce outlier sensitivity, and (c) momentum on the mean update.

name: Adaptive MPPI (temperature + noise)
tagline: MPPI as default but the temperature is upweighted when elite-value variance is low, and a global noise multiplier shrinks/grows by improvement signal.

key_hyperparams.name: temp_adapt_factor
key_hyperparams.role: max increase in T when variance is low

key_hyperparams.name: noise_adapt_rate
key_hyperparams.role: multiplicative noise scale step

key_hyperparams.name: improvement_threshold
key_hyperparams.role: trigger for noise growth/shrink

key_hyperparams.name: noise_scale bounds
key_hyperparams.role: clamp for global noise multiplier

init_recovers: Vanilla MPPI when both adapt factors=0
diff_from_baseline: Pure MPPI with two control loops: (i) temperature scales up when the elite value variance is low (sharpen on agreement), and (ii) the per-step Gaussian noise is shrunk on iterations where the best elite improves, grown otherwise.

name: MPPI + antithetic colored noise + warm start
tagline: MPPI scoring with elite retention plus paired-mirror sampling of per-trajectory AR(1) colored noise with random per-trajectory β.

key_hyperparams.name: keep_fraction
key_hyperparams.role: iCEM-style elite retention

key_hyperparams.name: β range
key_hyperparams.role: per-trajectory AR(1) correlation drawn each iter

key_hyperparams.name: noise scale
key_hyperparams.role: white-noise coefficient that preserves marginal variance

key_hyperparams.name: deterministic seed
key_hyperparams.role: always include the current mean rollout as a candidate

diff_from_baseline: Adds three sampling-side improvements over MPPI: per-trajectory AR(1) colored noise with random β, antithetic mirror pairing of noise, and an explicit deterministic mean rollout. Elites are also retained across iterations as in iCEM. Update rule is the same softmax MPPI.

name: Elite mixture with anchoring + hedging
tagline: iCEM-style retention + antithetic colored sampling, then mix MPPI weighted moments with a 'best elite anchor' and hedge std to disagreement.

key_hyperparams.name: corr
key_hyperparams.role: AR(1) colored-noise coefficient

key_hyperparams.name: keep_frac
key_hyperparams.role: elite retention fraction

key_hyperparams.name: trust
key_hyperparams.role: momentum on prior mean

key_hyperparams.name: best_mix
key_hyperparams.role: weight on best elite in proposal mean

key_hyperparams.name: hedge
key_hyperparams.role: lower-bound on σ via mean-vs-best disagreement

key_hyperparams.name: warm-start mix
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of mean(π warm-start) blended into init mean

key_hyperparams.name: exploration noise (train)
key_hyperparams.role: Gaussian perturbation added to selected action

key_hyperparams.name: top-k for selection
key_hyperparams.role: subset for multinomial sampling at training time

init_recovers: MPPI when keep_frac=0, best_mix=0, hedge=0, trust=0
diff_from_baseline: Layered: iCEM (elite retention, antithetic colored noise) + MPPI (softmax weighting) + a 'mixture' update that blends the weighted mean with the best elite trajectory, raises σ to the |weighted_mean − best_elite| disagreement, and at eval time picks the best elite outright. Also softly anchors the init mean to the policy warm-start mean.
